summary: After missing a weekend trip home, a congressman turned down a national TV interview to be home the next week.
realLife: A congressman with ten children, who campaigned for him and gave money unprompted, said that after missing a weekend trip home he turned down a network interview so he could go home the next week. His older daughters helped raise the younger siblings as second mothers.
gates: A seat is held at a capital away from home.
A weekend at home was missed.
weights: Value of the invitation to the career
inGame: A seat held, a household with children and a legislature away from home, with a press invitation as a news hook, can carry it.

turns.what: The official takes the interview and misses a second weekend.
turns.writesBack: Press standing rises; a strain note at home.

turns.what: The official goes home but takes the call from the car.
The official regrets the choice when the interview leads to a big story.
turns.pulledBy: A rival who took the slot.
turns.writesBack: A doubt line; the rival's news standing rises.
